name: building-with-typesafe-jev
description: Unofficial Claude Code skill for building with TypeSafe AI's Jev: the typed Choice/Score/Noul API, calibrated-confidence routing, field-tested anti-patterns, and a prior-art library of 150+ community projects sorted by implementation shape.

live_testing.title: Live testing
live_testing.description: Let the skill make a few real Jev API calls (about 10 per task, a fraction of a cent each) to test a design. Off: the skill designs from its API reference only and never looks for a key.

key_env_var.title: Key variable
key_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable that holds your TypeSafe API key. The name only, never the key itself.
